Check out the decklists from the Team Vintage Super League! To learn more about how the league works, [click here](https://vintagesuperleague.com/format-details/). You can see these decks in action Thursdays at 6 p.m. PT on [twitch.tv/magic](https://www.twitch.tv/magic).

* * *
